text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's finally time, Trainer. Soon will come the signal for the curtains to rise…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see what spectacle awaits me beyond those velvet drapes.
choice_data_list: It'll just be the usual track, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes, but each performance shifts and changes according to the players who take stage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Your rapport with your fellow actors, the ad-libs that come to mind…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: They're unpredictable and part of what makes a live performance so terrifying and entertaining!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Aah! Be still, my beating heart! Even it knows that today's race will surely be a good one!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Come now! No two performances are the same. Let's treat the audience to a once-in-a-lifetime show!
